# Upstream source

- Source: https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp
- Branch: `main`
- Imported and locally cleaned: 2026-11-01 (Asia/Shanghai)
- License: Apache-2.0; see the unchanged `LICENSE` file.

The initial import exported all 153 tracked files using `git archive`, without Git metadata or untracked files. This local copy was then cleaned at the user's request. It is not an unchanged upstream snapshot.

Local changes remove personal contact details, social and community links, sponsorship/donation material, personal promotion, and personal account examples. Promotional assets and contributor profile catalogs are omitted where present. Technical project identifiers, dependency/import paths, source/download links, licensing notices, and existing security controls remain. Modified documentation and example configuration carry a local modification notice.

No upstream installation, build, service start, browser/login, or publishing action was executed during import or cleanup. Cookies, credentials, and local account sessions are not included.

The personal Windows account path and n8n instance/credential references were replaced with generic setup data. Keep Bearer-token authentication, sensitive-file exclusions, and existing system protection. The upstream Windows antivirus-exclusion instructions were not executed.

Personal-environment recordings and selected screenshots were omitted because they exposed account names, avatars, browser session tokens, or original local deployment details. Their generic written instructions and non-personal examples remain.
